components.role: All four heads are answer-token copy heads; in A they copy the answer token in the prompt (the user's guess) into the output more strongly (abs +76 to +104, z +2.6 to +4.4 under two independent answer directions; mainly o_proj, also shared v_proj)
Global-attention copy head; copies the in-context answer token to the output more in A (z +4.5/+4.1, o_proj part +5.8)
The base model's cleanest copy head (copy score +0.99); stronger guess-copying in A (residual-metric z +4.4/+6.9)

Largest direct writer of the answer contrast (7.8x random); the top down_proj change (18% of energy) points along the answer direction and is spread over ~640 units (top loadings 467, 750, 961, 258); decides guess vs correct answer at the last step
Second-strongest writer of the answer contrast (6.3x); late answer selection
Copy head (copy score +0.99) with answer-token copying increased in A (+4.8/+1.7)

Most structured change in the network: rank-1 query change shared by heads 0, 1 and 3 (base position-tracking heads), reading a feature shared with the layer 7-10 query changes; re-routes where heads look; direction not signable from weights
Writes the answer contrast into the logits (4.9x random)
Copy-suppression head in the base; A suppresses the in-context answer token less (+2.3/+1.5)
Early mover of the answer token, with copying increased in A (+5.5/+4.0); weak, since layers 0 and 5 go the other way

evidence: Full-rank Adam-like fine-tune; magnitude statistics do not separate the models (movement-size test z=+1.3). Sign comes from copying circuits: (1) along a stable answer-token direction shared by early input deltas and late output deltas, A's heads copy the in-context answer token to the output more (summed z ~+55 overall, +38 in layers 12-17, 4-5 sigma against random-direction and sign-scrambled nulls); with a direction built without any layer 16/17 weights, all 8 layer-16/17 heads are positive (sum +24 vs null -0.4 +/- 4.8). (2) In the full residual space, A's o_proj moved toward re-emitting what each head's own v_proj reads (mean head z +0.6, about 5 sigma; specific to the matched value matrix; base copy heads +4.4 sigma, suppression heads +1.2 sigma). Copying the in-context guess is what sycophancy needs and what correct answering must suppress, so A is sycophantic. Routing (query/key) changes, led by the rank-1 layer-12 query change, alter where heads look but could not be signed from weights. The main caveat is the assumption that the in-context answer token is the user's guess rather than a listed option.
